name: Wolf Bride
source:
Drawn by dreams to your mother's childhood home, you find an unexpected connection with a dangerous and mysterious man.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Wolf_Bride]Choices Wikia[/url]]
